# Outreach Record Checklist

> Use this twice: once **before** the event, to set the record up correctly, and
> once **after**, to fill in the results before publishing.
>
> **Why this matters beyond record-keeping.** The Impact page is built by adding
> up your outreach records. A record with a wrong number publishes a wrong
> number, and it is much harder to unpick later than to get it right now. If you
> are not sure of a figure, leave the field empty and note it — never guess.

---

## Part 1 — Before the event

- [ ] Record created: **Outreach & Impact → Outreach → +**
- [ ] **Status set to `Upcoming`**
      > **The Studio defaults to `Completed`.** An event that has not happened
      > yet must be changed to `Upcoming`, or the website will publish a
      > completed event that never took place.
- [ ] Title describes the event plainly (under 80 characters)
- [ ] Theme: one clear health or nutrition subject
- [ ] Date: the planned date
- [ ] Location: Community / Town, Local Government Area, State (from the dropdown)
- [ ] Venue filled in if known
- [ ] Summary written (under 300 characters)
- [ ] Objectives listed
- [ ] Target population described
- [ ] Planned activities listed
- [ ] Partners and volunteers added as links, if known
- [ ] Published, so the public can see the event is coming

**Published as an announcement?** ☐ Yes ☐ No

---

## Part 2 — After the event: count before you type

Settle the numbers on paper first, then type them once. Do not add them up twice
and publish whichever figure looks better.

- [ ] Attendance register completed, or a tally kept at the door
- [ ] Number screened counted separately from attendance
      > A person who was screened was also **present**. Attendance includes
      > everybody; Screened counts only those who actually had a health check.
      > Screened must never be more than Attendance.
- [ ] Did anything go differently from the plan? Write it down now.

**Attendance (head count):** ____________
**Number screened:** ____________

- [ ] Attendance is a whole number
- [ ] Screened ≤ Attendance
- [ ] Any figure I am unsure about is left blank and flagged to the outreach
      manager, not guessed

---

## Part 3 — After the event: fill in the record

- [ ] **Status changed to `Completed`**
- [ ] **Date corrected to the date it actually happened**
- [ ] Total Attendance filled in
- [ ] Number Screened filled in — or left empty if nobody was screened
      > Do not enter 0. Empty means "nobody was screened"; 0 means a screening
      > happened and nobody attended, which is not the same thing.
- [ ] Activities Conducted: specific, not vague
      > "Waist and blood-pressure checks, handwashing demonstration, questions
      > and answers" — not "health talk".
- [ ] Key Results added, with a label, a number and a description
- [ ] Volunteers & Professionals linked to their Person records
- [ ] Partners & Sponsors linked to their Partner records
- [ ] Key Findings / Outcomes written honestly
      > Include what did not work or what you ran out of. An outreach report
      > that shows only successes is not useful to anybody.
- [ ] Follow-up Activity written, with a date
- [ ] Photographs added, with consent fields completed (see the image checklist)
- [ ] Testimonial added **only** if written publication consent exists
- [ ] Related Report / Resource linked, if you produced one
- [ ] **Verified by Outreach Manager** ticked

**Follow-up date:** ____________  **Who owns it:** ______________

---

## Part 4 — Consent: the part that must not be rushed

> No individual's health information from a screening appears anywhere on this
> website. Not in a photo caption, not in a testimonial, not in a number that
> identifies a person.
>
> You may publish **how many** people were screened. You may never publish
> **what was found**, or **who it was found in**.

- [ ] No individual's screening result, blood-pressure reading, weight, test
      result or diagnosis is recorded anywhere in this document
- [ ] No photograph of a child is used without written guardian consent, with
      "Does this image show anyone under 18?" set to Yes and "Guardian Consent
      Recorded" ticked
- [ ] No photograph of a pregnant or breastfeeding woman is used without her
      written consent
- [ ] No individual's result appears in a testimonial
- [ ] Every testimonial has "Publication Consent Obtained" ticked — from a
      real written agreement, not a verbal yes
- [ ] I know who took each photo and can find the consent paperwork
- [ ] Any image without consent is set to `Not for publication` and left in the
      record, rather than deleted, so the paperwork trail survives

**Where the written consent forms are stored:** ______________

---

## Part 5 — Before publishing

- [ ] Every number traces to a register, tally or report I can produce
- [ ] The date is the real date
- [ ] Status is `Completed`
- [ ] No individual's health information anywhere in the record
- [ ] All image consent fields complete
- [ ] Outreach manager has verified the record
- [ ] Someone has read the summary as if they were a member of the public
- [ ] Nothing in the record claims NHECOF did something it did not do

**Verified by:** ______________  **Date:** ______________

---

## Part 6 — What happens to the Impact page

Publishing this record can change the Impact page automatically. That is
intended, not a bug.

```
You publish this outreach record
        ↓
The website adds up Total Attendance across all published records
        ↓
The Impact Metric with Basis = Computed shows the new total
        ↓
The Impact page changes
```

**If the Impact page did not change, check in this order:**

1. Is the record actually **Published**, or still a saved draft?
2. Is **Status** still `Upcoming`?
3. Is the outreach **Approved**?
4. Is the relevant Impact Metric set to **Basis = Computed**? If someone set it
   to **Manual**, the number is typed in by hand and your record will not count
   towards it until that is changed.
5. Is the page cached? Wait a few minutes and reload.

**Never reconcile a disagreement by editing the outreach number.** Fix the
record, or if the totals genuinely conflict, raise it with the administrator
before either figure is published.

---

## Part 7 — After publishing

- [ ] Opened the live page and checked it reads correctly
- [ ] Checked the photos that were meant to appear, and none that should not
- [ ] Checked the Impact page figure is consistent with the record
- [ ] Shared the original attendance register and consent forms with the
      outreach manager for filing
- [ ] Noted any correction needed for later

**Date published:** ______________  **Checked by:** ______________
